description: The real, npm-installed lodash.template@4.5.0's sole export (module.exports = template;) is called directly from the entrypoint on a caller-supplied template string.
reason: template() is lodash.template's entire module.exports -- a single, unambiguous CommonJS default export, exactly the pattern VulnTrace's export modeling already handles (see call-graph.test.ts's 'resolves a named function expression assigned via module.exports'). It is called directly (render() -> template(userTemplate)(data)) with no intervening indirection. A human analyst reading this file has no ambiguity: this is a real, reachable call to the exact function GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm/CVE-2021-23337 names as vulnerable (code injection via crafted 'imports' option key names).
